notes.title: NAIR 5.0.0
notes.content:
NAIR version 5.0.0 adds a new major feature: customizable game modes.

[h2]Custom Game Modes[/h2]
[list]
[*] A new button has been added, under the Discord button on the main menu, allowing you to create custom game rules.
[*] Custom game settings are saved as "modes" which can be played through the main menu, like any other mode.
[*] All modes are also compatible with online play, and support rollback.
[*] Game rules include tweaking the player's movement stats, and toggling new abilities such as airdashing.
[*] Game modes are saved as individual JSON files, which can be edited in any standard text editor. This should allow you to set values outside of what the in game editor normally allows.
[list]
[*] But it's not my fault if something breaks, I warned you!
[*](But also tell me if it does so I can fix it.)[/list][*] This feature is not considered "done"- if there are things you'd like to see added to the customization suite, please let me know.
[/list]

[h2]New Default Mode: Random[/h2]
[list]
[*] The "Random" game mode picks random game settings in a certain range every time you open it.
[*] This game mode is not fair or balanced.
[*] Good luck!
[/list]


[h2]Other tweaks[/h2]
[list]
[*] A combo counter has been added.
[*] A new title screen to celebrate NAIR's 5th anniversary.
[*] The colors of the title logo will now change depending on your custom colors for Player 1 and Player 2.
[*] You can now enter any game mode (NAIR, Oneshot, etc) with only one controller.
[/list]

That's all for this update! The next major update should feature CPU opponents.
Thanks for sticking around for so long. This game's community has brought me boundless happiness over the years, and I will continue to update it as long as there are still people to play it.
- Holly

notes.title: NAIR 3.5.0
notes.content:
NAIR 3.5.0 adds two highly requested features: custom colors, and music!

[h2]Music & Settings[/h2]
[list]
[*] Two new songs, composed by Max Miller (aka Funbil - [url=https://www.patreon.com/MaxMiller]their website[/url])
[*] Every sound effect has been rebalanced to accomodate the addition of music, also thanks to Max (my goat fr)
[*] Individual music and SFX volume sliders have been added to the game options.
[*] Also, your settings are now saved- NAIR will remember your light/dark & volume configuration
[/list]

[h2]Custom Colors![/h2]
[list]
[*] You can now associate custom colors with your controls tag!
[*] Each tag can store 4 colors- body color and weapon color, for both light and dark themes.
[*] You can also associate colors with the 'Player 1' and 'Player 2' tags, which will effectively change the default colors from red & blue to whatever you like!
[*] Custom colors can be used online- by selecting a tag when going to the online menu. If you choose not to, the Player 1 tag will be used instead.
[list]
[*] Your opponent in an online match will see the same colors as you- so if you go online with the dark theme, your opponent will see your dark theme colors, even if they are using light theme.
[/list]
[/list]

DAIR is almost done, and both music and colors will ship with the game day 1.

notes.title: Patch 3.3.0
notes.content:
[u]Gameplay Changes:[/u]
[list]
[*] Wavedash loses less speed over time
[list]
[*] 5% speed per frame -> 2% speed/frame
[/list][*] Crouch loses less speed while sliding
[list]
[*] 20%/frame -> 15%/frame
[/list][*] Ground speed is retained when you jump
[list]
[*] This allows you to exceed the maximum air speed of 15
[list]
[*] While over the maximum air speed, you will lose speed at a rate of 0.7%/frame
[/list][*] Dash, run, and wavedash are all faster than the max air speed, so anything other than neutral jump will give you a faster burst of speed.
[/list][*] Wavedashing is fully actionable after frame 3.
[list]
[*] The list of possible actions that will cancel a wavedash includes crouching, dashing, and jumping.
[/list]
[/list]

While this list is short, the impact on gameplay will be extremely significant. The new wavedash is an incredibly potent swiss army knife that allows you to move on the ground with a new level of precision, and that lets you launch yourself through the air incredibly fast (and, again, pretty precisely).

Because of the analog nature of this tool, and the sheer range of possibility, I expect it to take a long time for this feature to be fully optimized, but when it happens it will be beautiful.

I will be releasing a large number of small updates over the coming weeks, addressing frequently asked for features and much needed changes. This was originally going to be one of those "small patches", and in a way it kind of is, but the effect it has on gameplay is major enough that I'm dubbing this 3.3.0. 3.2.X only lasted 11 days. :p

I'm releasing these patch notes a few hours before the update itself, while I get the itch build ready, but if you want you can try it early by going into the Betas tab and selecting "3.2.0-beta".

Anyways. There's a lot more to be excited for in the coming months. It's gonna be a wild ride. Hope to see you on it.

EDIT: For clarity sake, here are the wavedash changes from 3.2.0 (they're relevant):
[list]
[*] When performing a wavedash, the player's speed is multiplied by 1.4 on the first frame.
[*] When performing a wavedash, the player's speed is reduced by [strike]5%[/strike] 2% each frame.
[*] [strike]Wavedashes can now be jump cancelled 3 frames earlier.[/strike]
[*] When buffering an airdodge from jumpsquat, a wavedash will occur regardless of stick direction.
(This allows keyboard/dpad users to get an optimal wavedash by simply holding left/right.)
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 3.2.0
notes.content:
NAIR 3.2.0 finally arrives, with several major changes. This is, in my opinion, the most exciting patch since release.

[u]Gameplay Changes[/u]
[list]
[*] When performing a wavedash, the player's speed is multiplied by 1.4 on the first frame.
[*] When performing a wavedash, the player's speed is reduced by 5% each frame.
[*] Wavedashes can now be jump cancelled 3 frames earlier.
[*] When buffering an airdodge from jumpsquat, a wavedash will occur regardless of stick direction.
[list]
[*] This allows keyboard/dpad users to get an optimal wavedash by simply holding left/right.
[/list]
[/list]

[u]Feature Additions[/u]
[list]
[*] A new gamemode has been added: One Shot.
[list]
[*] One Shot, along with any  other game modes downloaded from external sources (wink), are all compatible with online play.
[*] In One Shot, your attack takes 23 frames to come out, but will instakill your opponent. There is no time limit. The mode is Best of One.
[*] Air speed, air acceleration, ground movement speed, etc are all faster than base NAIR.
[*] You have 3 double jumps.
[*] A number of other movement and hitbox tweaks.
[/list]
[*] Added a new achievement related to One Shot.
[*] Online matches can now be spectated.
[list]
[*] Joining an online match that already has its player 1/2 assigned will join as a spectator.
[*] You can join a match that has already started- you will enter after the game resets.
[/list]
[*] Crossplay
[list]
[*] More on this in the next section.
[/list]
[/list]

[u]Feature Changes[/u]
[list]
[*] The netcode has been replaced.
[list]
[*] While still using GGPO as a base, Steam P2P has been replaced with Epic Online Services.
[*] The most important thing this adds is cross-play with the Itch.io release of this game!
[/list]
[/list]

There, it's done. I've been intending to add these features since before release, and I am extremely happy to finally get it out.
We will be holding a One Shot tournament on the community Discord in the next few weeks, watch out for that! I'll also be streaming it. <3
Alright, I'm going into hibernation for a few months. You'll hear from me when I awake- I still have more free content updates planned for NAIR.

notes.title: Patch 3.1.3
notes.content:
[h2]Patch Notes for Version 3.1.3:[/h2]
[u]Gameplay Changes:[/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed an inconsistency with the player's attack.
[list]
[*] Previously, if the player landed during an attack while facing left, their position would shift a few pixels to the left. This will no longer occur.
[/list][/list]
[u]Changes: [/u]
[list]
[*] Adjusted the "Clutch" achievement.
[list]
[*] Previously, you needed to go from losing to winning in the last 3 seconds, on top of some other conditions. The timer has been extended to 4 seconds. You can also earn the achievement if the match ends in a draw, if the outcome is favorable for you (you were up in round points),
[/list][/list]
[u]Bug Fixes: [/u]
[list][*] Fixed the scaling on gamecube controllers.
[list]
[*] Previously, you'd only be able to hit ~0.9 on a gamecube controller's joystick, causing you to have inferior air drift and airdodge length compared to any other controller. This has been patched.
[/list]
[*] An attempt was made to improve the framerate in menus with a gamecube controller attached,
[/list]

As a reminder, I am referring to using a mayflash adapter set to PC mode. If your gamecube controllers are showing up as xbox controllers, try disabling PS4 Controller support in Big Picture Mode.

Love,
Teridax

notes.title: Patch 3.1.2
notes.content:
[h2]Patch Notes for Version 3.1.2:[/h2]
[u]Gameplay Changes:[/u]
[list]
[*] Adjusted the crouch; height is now 115.
[list]
[*] In 3.1.0, the crouch had a height value of 140. A mistake in 3.1.1 caused it to become 100. While this was a mistake, I liked the new utility I saw from the crouch in tournament play. That being said, it's [i]very[/i] strong right now, so I've reverted it a little. It's still much closer to the good crouch than the old one, but hopefully more reasonable.
[/list][/list]
[u]UI Changes: [/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed a framerate issue with the menus, buttons, logos etc.
[list]
[*] These should all play at the intended framerate now, on all monitors.
[/list][*] Removed the Matchmaking button.
[list]
[*] One of the most common complaints I get about this game is that nobody is on matchmaking. Indeed, most people find matches in the discord or in private. I have removed the button temporarily to try and avoid confusion. In the future, I will be investigating more options to connect to players.
[/list]
[/list]

All of these changes were in 3.2.0, which was slated to release around now. But as the month rolls on, I realize I am not finding the time to work on that update. I decided to bring these features forward while I continue to work on the core of 3.2.0, which is coming [i]soon[/i].
In the next update, look forward to cross-platform multiplayer with Itch.io, a new game mode, and some more.

(Or, perchance, you can access the new gamemode right now in the discord!)

Love,
Teridax

notes.title: Patch 3.1.0
notes.content:
[h2]Patch Notes for Version 3.1.0: [/h2]
[u]Gameplay Changes[/u]
[list]
[*] The landing lag accrued by landing during an airdodge is now jump cancellable in the last 7 frames.
[list]
[*] This makes wavevdashes actionable much earlier, with effectively 1/2 the lag.
[/list][*] Air acceleration is increased by 0.04 pixels/frame^2.
[list]
[*] This sounds small, but gives you enough air control to walljump 2 extra times in one leap!
[/list][*] Crouching height decreased by 10 pixels.
[*] Landing animation height decreased by 15 pixels.
[*] In jumpsquat, you now move at 0.5x your previous horizontal velocity.
[list]
[*] Previously you stopped. This shouldn't impact gameplay, as it only lasts 3 frames; but it looks smoother as you no longer come to a complete halt when jumping.
[/list][*] When crouching out of a run or after landing, you conserve momentum and slide for a few frames.
[*] When standing after landing, you conserve some momentum and slide for a few frames.
[list]
[*] These also extend the length of a wavedash, if you don't cancel it with a jump or dash. Also makes it easier to conserve momentum between multiple jumps.
[/list][*] When jumping out of a crouch, you now start at a speed determined by the position of your controller, maxing out at 0.5x maximum ground speed in either direction.
[list]
[*] Previously, you would jump with the velocity of whatever you were doing before crouching, letting you store the running speed in a crouch indefinitely.
[*] This is [i]added[/i] to the crouches' existing velocity, meaning if you are sliding forwards you will have a harder time jumping back, and vice versa.
[/list][*] Nair hitbox extended in the back.
[list]
[*] The front hit was slightly larger than the visual, but the back hit was not. This makes the back hit more consistent with the front hit. It also covers a small part of the visual that was not covered by a hitbox. See the end of the document for a before/after.
[/list][/list][u]Feature Changes[/u]
[list]
[*] Renamed "1 Player" mode to "Training" mode.
[*] The timer no longer decreases in training mode, and the score objects have been removed.
[*] In training mode, the health bar resets to neutral when a combo drops (is considered no longer true).
[/list][u]Bug Fixes[/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the "restart" button caused desyncs online.
[*] "You are offline" and "no open lobbies" menus now respect the dark theme.
[*] Fixed an issue where the health bar and other UI animated unevenly.
[/list]

[u]Hitbox before/after:[/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41031746/eaf067da2faa1c9c1804bd9ad5991bd8fc2f5788.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41031746/6dfeb45b3989a508c6bc96c8e9eff448e42584ac.png[/img]

[h2]Planned changes in future versions:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Controller rebinding
[*] Crossplat with Itch.io
[*] And more......! :^)
[/list]

Thanks everyone for playing, we had a very successful launch month and I'm so happy with our community.
Sorry this update took so long, we did a lot of testing in the beta branch in the official discord. You should join it, if you're interested in contributing!

notes.title: Patch 3.0.1
notes.content:
[h3]Gameplay Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] It is no longer possible to "lock" buttons, rendering them unusable.
[*] Pressing attack or dodge during landing lag will no longer buffer a jump.
[*] Nerfed Redtangle
[/list]
[h3]UI Enhancements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Pressing the "Ready" key while you are alone in a lobby will now post a message saying "no you can't do that"
[*] New message is displayed when trying to join a lobby when nobody is hosting
[*] Player hurtboxes are slightly more transparent, making it a little easier to tell which character is which
[/list]
[h3]Other bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] UI graphics related to score (pennants, "Game!", etc) now rollback properly
[*] Leaving a 2 person lobby, then joining matchmaking clears the name in P2 slot correctly
[*] Having >8 controllers plugged in no longer warps the controllers' sprites on the controller select menu
[*] The "On/Off" indicators for dark mode, hitbox mode should now be accurate when opening the options menu
[*] Fixed round-end achievements not getting checked for the last round of a game
[*] Fixed a bug where a player could permanently turn gray after airdodging during a rollback
[/list]

The changes to gameplay make this version incompatible with previous versions of the game. 3.0.1 will only be able to play online with other 3.0.1 users (or any future patch that doesnt change gameplay).
Unfortunately I didn't have the code for this in 3.0.0, so 3.0.0 users can join 3.0.1 games. (Not the other way around). Doing this will cause desyncs. It won't impact any future updates.

notes.title: NAIR: Supported Controllers, 3.0.0, known issues, and more!
notes.content:
Hi there everybody!
It's Teridax, from Bonks, but you can call me Hailey. Or the other way around.
I've got a host of things to talk about today, and NAIR releases on Steam in just a couple hours, so I'm going to try and get through it quickly.


First, let's get to what everyone really cares about......
[h2]Officially Supported Controllers: [/h2]
[list]
[*]XBOX One, 360, the new one, etc
[*]PS4
[*]Switch Pro Controller
[*]Gamecube (Using Mayflash Adapter, set to PC mode)*
[*]Most Generic/DInput controllers
[/list]
If your controller isn't on this list, it will probably still work via the magic of Steam Input. 
Steam Controller is also supposed to work and have a fun in-game sprite, but I would have to get mine out of the box to verify that.

Next, I am excited to announce the things nobody wants to hear:
[h2]Known Issues (and Solutions):[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Issue:[/b] Directional input doesn't work on most menus if a Mayflash Gamecube Controller Adapter is plugged in.
[*] [b]Solution:[/b] Unplug your adapter, navigate to the "controller select" screen of whatever game mode you're playing, and plug it back in. Continue as normal. Worst case scenario, the menus still work [i]sometimes[/i] so mashing the arrow keys on your keyboard until it works should also work.
[/list]

Alright, next up on the list: how to play! Considering this is a Steam launch, I figure a number of you probably haven't played this game before.
[h2]How to play NAIR, a step by step guide:[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Jump. (Z, J, or Space key; X, LB, or LT on Xbox; Square, L1, or L2 on PS4; L, X, or Y on Gamecube)
[*] Hold forward. (Arrow keys, WASD, Left Stick, or DPAD. Maybe right stick, I don't remember)
[*] Mash Attack until it hits or you land. (X or K key; A button on Xbox and Gamecube; X button on PS4)
[*] Optional: Airdodge. (Hold any direction, then: C or L key; RB or RT on xbox; R1 or R2 on PS4; Z or R on Gamecube)
[/olist]
Btw, use Enter as your start button, Backspace as your back button, and Esc as your pause button. Controllers use Start and B.

Next up, I'm going to plug the official 
[h2]Discord[/h2]
for this game. Yes, we have one, I know, it's crazy.
Anyways, here's the link: [url=https://discord.gg/ZPPmquA9R4]discord.gg/ZPPmquA9R4[/url]
There's also a big button in game that will take you there.
We are going to run tournaments here! Sound interesting? Your hour 1 Redtangle the best to ever do it? Join. 

I am now going to try and write a couple month's worth of patch notes.
[h2]Patch Notes for Version 3.0.0:[/h2]
All updates since 2.0.1
[u]Gameplay changes:[/u]
[list]
[*] You can now buffer a walljump out of an attack.
[*] The code that lets you do that was commented out, with a comment reading "This causes bugs." I don't remember writing that or what the bug was. Sounds like new tech waiting to be discovered!
[*] The player's hurtbox now displays as yellow while in hitstun, when viewing hitboxes.
[/list]
[u]New features:[/u]
[list]
[*] Switch from UDP-style netcode to Steam backed netcode. Automatically handles all the technical aspects of connecting to another player, ie; IP address management, port forwarding, etc. Thank god, that was gross.
[*] Online Lobby system. Nothing fancy, just does all the above stuff.
[*] Steam Achievements!
[*] Funny discord button
[*] Fullscreen toggle button
[*] Brought back 1.X.X animation and sound to all the Menus.
[*] Support for the analog zone of Gamecube controller triggers; half presses will get detected now.
[*] Added Ping and Rollback Frame indicators while in gameplay.
[/list]
[u]Removed:[/u]
[list]
[*] Manual IP Address/Port connections; trust me, the new stuff is better.
[/list]
[u]Improvements and bug fixes:[/u]
[list]
[*] New sprite for the 'ready' indicator on controller select screen.
[*] All menus animate into each other slightly better.
[*] Most menus now support the "B" button, letting you return to the previous menu.
[*] Added more default buttons such as WASD.
[*] Game is no longer locked to 1080p or 16:9. Wall sprites added for people with wider than 16:9 aspect ratios.
[*] I hid da mouse cursor
[*] Fixed some issues with Pro Controller on menus.
[*] Game is much less likely to crash online.
[*] Fixed the game not actually pausing with the pause menu open in offline matches.
[*] Fixed a number of interactions with the Dark Theme.
[*] The font should be much more readable and less cut off.
[*] All buttons using the font instead of sprites will also change text color when highlighted.
[/list]

That's all I can think of, for now. But I do wanna address a few things; most importantly, the game's network backend will be changing again from Steam to something else in the coming weeks. This is to enable crossplay with people who got/get the game from other platforms. This is most likely going to be EOS, but who knows. Expect version 3.1.0.......... sometime.

Speaking of updates, there are a few things I want to add still. Like, older versions of NAIR (pre rollback) had controller rebinding, and it's very important that I bring that back imo. Alternate types of matchmaking would be nice, I think. Among some other changes. If the game finds an audience, I will keep working on it, I promise.

Ok, ok, I'm done, I promise. And if you'll excuse me, I gotta get back to playing Bionicle: Heroes on my Nintendo 3DS.

[b][u]NAIR releases tonight at 11:00pm EST.[/u][/b]
I'll see you on the battle field.
-ːf1_batː
